deploy_limit_per_lap_mj.source: UNRESOLVED: FIA Section C Technical Issue 20 Articles C5.2.7-C5.2.10 specify instantaneous power, ES SOC excursion and Recharge limits, not a generic per-lap deployment budget; no substitute may be invented

harvest_limit_per_lap_mj.note: Base Recharge limit. Article C5.2.10 and Sporting Article B7.2.1 allow competition-specific reductions/additional conditions; the event-specific value remains a required final input.
harvest_limit_per_lap_mj.source: FIA Section C Technical Issue 20 Article C5.2.10, p. 63, https://www.fia.com/system/files/documents/fia_2026_f1_regulations_-_section_c_technical_-_iss_20_-_2026-08-05.pdf

store_capacity_mj.note: The physical bound on ers_soc_est_mj, a different constraint from the per-lap flow limits above. A car can be short of deploy budget with a full store, or the reverse; conflating them produces a twin that is right about total energy and wrong about what the car may legally do next (section 28).
store_capacity_mj.source: UNRESOLVED: FIA Section C Technical Issue 20 Article C5.2.9, p. 63, https://www.fia.com/system/files/documents/fia_2026_f1_regulations_-_section_c_technical_-_iss_20_-_2026-08-05.pdf; the rule gives a 4MJ maximum SOC excursion, not the physical ES capacity

lap_length_m.note: Telemetry distance is integrated along the path the car actually drove, so it reads shorter than the homologated circuit length: straight-line integration between samples undershoots the arc through a corner. The shortfall tracks corner density, from -0.61% at Monza to -2.58% at the Hungaroring. USE THE MEASURED VALUE. CP-05 segments on telemetry distance, so segment boundaries must live in the same coordinate system; the published figure is a sanity cross-check only, and is not interchangeable with it.
lap_length_m.source: median max(distance) over 30 sampled Race laps, lap 1 excluded

detection_gap_s.note: Gap threshold at the Detection Line for Overtake to arm. 1.0 s is the long-standing DRS threshold and is a plausible starting point, but it is a carried-over assumption, not a 2026 citation.
detection_gap_s.source: UNRESOLVED: FIA Section B Sporting Issue 08, Article B7.2.1b(vii), https://www.fia.com/system/files/documents/fia_2026_f1_regulations_-_section_b_sporting_-_iss_08_-_2026-08-05_7.pdf; the public regulation requires a competition-provided Detection Gap but does not state its event value here

normal.note: The 350 kW absolute cap applies below 290 km/h; above it the Article C5.2.8i formula is 1800 - 5*speed below 340 km/h, then 6900 - 20*speed below 345 km/h, then zero.
normal.source: FIA Section C Technical Issue 20, Article C5.2.7 and C5.2.8i, pp. 63-64, https://www.fia.com/system/files/documents/fia_2026_f1_regulations_-_section_c_technical_-_iss_20_-_2026-08-05.pdf

override.note: The 350 kW absolute cap intersects 7100 - 20*speed at 337.5 km/h; the Overtake-active curve reaches zero at 355 km/h.
override.source: FIA Section C Technical Issue 20, Article C5.2.7 and C5.2.8ii, p. 63, https://www.fia.com/system/files/documents/fia_2026_f1_regulations_-_section_c_technical_-_iss_20_-_2026-08-05.pdf

separation_speed_kmh.note: Below this the curves coincide, so override confers no power advantage and the mode is not observable. The M35 discriminator must return UNKNOWN below it rather than NORMAL (section 20.2).
separation_speed_kmh.source: Calculated from the 350 kW absolute cap in FIA Section C Technical Issue 20 Article C5.2.7 and the non-Overtake formula in Article C5.2.8i, p. 63, https://www.fia.com/system/files/documents/fia_2026_f1_regulations_-_section_c_technical_-_iss_20_-_2026-08-05.pdf

overtake_disabled_conditions.note: Observed in the 2026 message feed: 51 OVERTAKE ENABLED and 23 OVERTAKE DISABLED messages across the season, alongside 11 Safety Car and 31 VSC deployments. The list is the observed association, not a cited regulation.

race_control.source: race-control messages in the raw mirror, extracted by scripts/data/extract_race_control.py

regulation_snapshot.note: The published regulation, applicable competition configuration and this encoding are kept separately auditable (section 6). Final mode additionally requires every consumed value to be resolved and sourced.
